experiment.topic: Volatility compression and mean reversion in BTC-USD using hourly realized volatility
experiment.hypothesis: When hourly realized volatility in BTC-USD exceeds a 20-period threshold of 0.08, price reversion to mean occurs within the next 12 hours with a probability greater than 70%.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If hourly realized volatility in BTC-USD exceeds 0.08 over a 20-period window and the price does not revert to a mean level within the next 12 hours, the hypothesis is falsified.
